name: Meppen (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided light blue over white, charged at the centre with the city arms of Meppen (a red cross on yellow above a red bar).
history: Municipal flag of Meppen; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Meppen arms — cross and bar on yellow
